_comment: The business registry. Onboarding is a commit: see businesses.py for why.
A business IS its treasury address. `consented` gates the NAME only; an
unconsented business still counts and still gets a published ledger, under
`policy_wallet` empty means the operator can price and meter for them but
cannot spend — which is what an evaluation looks like, and a real state.
`chain` is per business because mainnet and testnet totals are reported
separately and must never be added together.

businesses.name: ACR buyer-agent fleet
businesses.note: Our own agent fleet's spend on machine services. 75 real exact-scheme Gateway settlements across 7 sellers and 4 units (0.325467 USDC), so the meter has genuine consumption to count and PAR has genuine price dispersion to measure against. Those settlements are dated 2026-09-12/13 and therefore PREDATE the Tameion window; what is in-window is the onboarding and every decision made since. No PolicyWallet yet, so the operator prices and meters here and cannot spend: `spends: false` on every surface.
